UI_ViewpointCompass_Options_DirectionOnl: Show only the current cardinal/intercardinal direction; hide the ruler, degrees, map markers, faction players, and A-Life NPCs.
UI_ViewpointCompass_Options_OpenWaypoint: Open or close Compass Markers. Set to None to disable the shortcut.
UI_ViewpointCompass_Options_RequireCompa: Require a Compass item to show the compass
When enabled, you must carry the vanilla Compass item. The server can enforce this requirement.
UI_ViewpointCompass_Options_CompassScale: Scales the entire compass, including its labels, ticks, and markers.
UI_ViewpointCompass_Markers_Confirm: Remove all compass markers? Map annotations will be kept.
UI_ViewpointCompass_Markers_Empty: No compass markers. Add a destination from Map Symbols.
UI_ViewpointCompass_Markers_Select: Click a map annotation. Esc or right click cancels.
UI_ViewpointCompass_Markers_Background: Background for markers inside the compass
UI_ViewpointCompass_Options_ShowFactionP: Show nearby faction members on compass
Requires Viewpoint Compass on the server. The server can disable this feature or limit its range.
UI_ViewpointCompass_Options_FactionPlaye: Detect same-faction players within 25–1000 meters, up to the server's configured maximum. Default: 250 meters.
UI_ViewpointCompass_Options_ShowALifeMar: Show A-Life NPCs on the compass
Requires Viewpoint Threat Detector. Hostile is red, Careful yellow, Neutral white, Friendly green, and Allied blue.
UI_ViewpointCompass_Options_ALifeMarkerR: Maximum distance for A-Life compass markers. One tile is shown as one meter.
UI_ViewpointCompass_Options_BlinkNewALif: Blink new Hostile and Careful NPCs
Hostile and Careful markers blink briefly when they first appear on the compass.
UI_ViewpointCompass_Options_HostileClose: Hostile markers keep blinking within this distance. Set to 0 to disable close-range blinking.
